svg.title: Pakistan's National SDG Framework: Policy Cascade
svg.desc: Diagram illustrating the multi-level governance cascade of Pakistan's National SDG Framework from federal policy to provincial departments and local schools.

text.tspan: Pakistan's National SDG Framework: Policy Cascade
1. Federal Leadership: Planning Commission of Pakistan
- National SDG Framework: defines 3 priority tiers across 169 targets
- Inter-provincial coordination, federal reporting, and national baseline setting
2. Provincial Localization: Planning and Development Boards (Sindh)
- Provincial SDG Support Units: aligning budgets with local provincial needs
- School Education and Literacy Department (SELD) and curriculum frameworks
- Teacher education curriculum and professional standards alignment
3. Local School and Classroom Action: Teachers and Learners
- School development plans: water hygiene, tree planting, and energy saving
- Classroom pedagogy: inquiry lessons linking curriculum topics to SDGs
- Community outreach: pupil-led surveys and collaborative clean-up drives
